items.summary: Legal risk disposition: blocked for public launch and rights-dependent monetization; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, do not send external permission outreach, expand alerts, enable monetization, deploy, or change tracking. Evidence: Woot public terms do not establish commercial/public redistribution rights; 0 of 4 legal launch tasks are closed; accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security gates are blocked; compliance is technical-only with 34 pass, 14 fail, and 11 unknown; analytics and revenue attribution remain incomplete. Progress: 0/4 tasks closed; no task is closable on current evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix, then route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review and owner authorization. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Close none until the stated evidence is attached and reviewed. Next evidence action: produce one read-only bundle covering field provenance and rights, storage/caching/display/derivatives/alerts, data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.
